snippet.title: Fnaf Online Multiplayer (0.6.0-alpha) Gameplay (by @HeftigHD)
snippet.description:
Upcoming Fnaf fangame where you and your friends take on distinct roles inside the FNAF 1 pizzeria. Work together—or fall apart—as each player is responsible for a different part of your collective survival. 

This is a cooperative online multiplayer experience built from the ground up with communication, power management, and teamwork at its core.

 Thanks to ‪@HeftigHD‬​ for the gameplay footage!

Itch page: https://brian-mpz.itch...​

GameJolt page: https://gamejolt.com/g...​

Playtesting Discord Server: https://discord.gg/93Tvc7YZUc

#fnaf #fnafcoop #fivenightsatfreddys #multiplayer #online
